summary: Enhance your knowledge with our course on Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism in the Banking Sector. Stay compliant and secure.
lede: AML training helps banking professionals assess customer risk, review alerts and document escalation decisions. Learners practise customer due diligence, risk scoring, beneficial ownership analysis, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and suspicious activity reporting. They also prepare investigation notes and audit trails to support evidence-based decisions about potential money laundering and terrorist financing.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who need to detect, investigate, escalate, and document money laundering and terrorist financing risk with defensible banking controls.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic working knowledge of banking operations, customer onboarding, and compliance processes. Prior experience in AML, KYC, transaction monitoring, or financial crime operations is helpful but not essential. No coding or programming is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing customer files, transaction records, and control checklists. The course introduces concepts at a foundation-to-intermediate level, with operational application focused on banking controls, while advanced model tuning, enterprise-wide system configuration, and technical engineering are covered only conceptually.
